edits.name: headquarters
edits.prompt: Edit this production game sprite atlas ONLY to clean its transparency. Preserve every building exactly: architecture, colours, details, number, arrangement, size, positions, resolution, and level progression. Remove ALL gray haze/gradient outside buildings, ALL white or multicoloured fringe/speckles/halos along silhouettes, ALL shadows and backgrounds between and behind buildings. Outside actual building silhouettes must be fully transparent alpha=0, including spaces between antennas and towers. Use clean antialiased edges without light matte contamination. Preserve blue/amber lights INSIDE the buildings, but no wide external glow. Keep every building separate, fully visible, no cropping. No text, no new objects, no background. Output a clean transparent sprite sheet.
